mathematical_object: Width-one regular Reuleaux odd polygons and their planar Cheeger constants
scientific_integrity: The exact asymptotic coefficients follow from the stated polar-area identity and analytic implicit-function proof; numerical tests are supplemental.
scientific_limitations: An asymptotic for odd n, not a finite-n closed-form root; closely related 2026 minimization full text was inaccessible, and no universal novelty is certified.
title: Sharp two-term Cheeger convergence law for regular Reuleaux polygons
